title: Harness re-injects the deferred-tool catalog nearly every turn during long shell waits
wanted_capability: Inject the optional/deferred tool catalog at most once per session (or only on actual registry change, hash-gated), not repeatedly during shell-poll loops. Long cargo waits currently receive the catalog on nearly every turn; dispatched gpt-5.5 bros burn ~7-12K fresh input tokens per poll turn and narrate around it ("the optional tool catalog arrived again") dozens of times per run.
fallback_used: None — bros correctly ignore the injections, but the token+latency tax per turn remains; orchestrator absorbing it as slow waves.
evidence: thread-935b467d wave sessions: W3a 327 turns/46m, W4a 321 turns/~50m, W4b 177 turns 1.22M fresh input (6.9K/turn) vs 18M cached
bro narrations contain 30-50 consecutive 'optional tool catalog arrived' turns per long cargo wait
resolution_note: Fixed in 7f0bad8: SystemPrompt three-way split (stable/ambient/volatile); Responses transport persists the manifest into the buffer hash-gated on change (codex idiom), resets on compaction, carries the hash in the v2 session snapshot. Live-verified: probe session bcab81ef shows exactly one persisted developer manifest item across the run and zero catalog narration; anthropic/chat transports unchanged in behavior.
